summary: Customer Onboarding Packets feature fully tested. All 23 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend public form and master admin panel both work correctly. All 7 wizard steps render, autosave works, CSV equipment import works, submit flow shows confirmation. Admin panel has all required elements: New Packet button, status filters, create dialog with tier/CRM dropdowns, packet cards with counts, detail dialog with share URL and provision/reject/delete buttons.

issues: Minor HTML nesting warning: Badge (div) inside p tag causes hydration warning in dev mode. Not a functional issue but should be fixed for cleaner console.

backend_master_admin_create_packet.details: Creates packet with token, share_url; validates tier (starter/pro/enterprise)

backend_master_admin_update_packet.details: Updates allowed fields (customer_display_name, target_tier, review_notes, etc.)

backend_master_admin_delete_packet.details: Deletes non-provisioned packets; returns 400 for provisioned

backend_master_admin_provision_packet.details: Validates packet, creates org+sites+users+equipment+suppliers+contracts atomically, returns summary counts

backend_master_admin_provision_validatio.details: Returns 400 with validation errors (legal_name, postcode, email, site, owner required)

backend_master_admin_crm_companies.details: Returns CRM company list for prefill dropdown

backend_rbac_403_for_non_admin.details: All master admin endpoints return 403 for non-master-admin user (lee.somers@pulsefitness.com)

backend_public_get_packet.details: Returns packet without auth; hides created_by, provisioned_organization_id

backend_public_save_draft.details: Saves draft content (organisation, sites, staff, equipment, suppliers, contracts)

backend_public_submit.details: Validates and marks submitted; returns 400 with errors when missing required fields

frontend_public_form_loads.details: Customer onboarding form renders at /onboarding/{token} with data-testid='customer-onboarding-form'

frontend_all_7_steps.details: All 7 steps navigable: organisation, sites, staff, equipment, suppliers, contracts, review

frontend_equipment_csv_paste.details: CSV paste field (data-testid='equipment-csv-paste') accepts text, btn-csv-import adds rows

frontend_add_remove_buttons.details: Add/remove buttons work for sites, staff, equipment, suppliers, contracts

frontend_admin_panel_renders.details: Admin panel renders at /master-admin with data-testid='admin-onboarding-packets'

frontend_admin_new_packet_button.details: New Packet button (data-testid='btn-new-packet') opens create dialog

frontend_admin_create_dialog.details: Create dialog (data-testid='create-packet-dialog') has name, tier dropdown, CRM prefill dropdown

frontend_admin_detail_dialog.details: Detail dialog (data-testid='packet-detail-dialog') shows share URL, provision/reject/delete buttons

frontend_admin_status_filters.details: All 6 filter pills work: all, draft, submitted, approved, provisioned, rejected

action_items: Minor: Fix HTML nesting in CustomerOnboardingForm.js line 136-137 - Badge (div) should not be inside p tag
critical_code_review_comments: Provision endpoint sends password-reset emails via Resend - may not deliver in test env but does not cause failures
Magic-link tokens stored in password_reset_tokens collection with purpose='onboarding_setup'
Atomic rollback implemented in provision endpoint - if any step fails, all created records are deleted
Public endpoints correctly hide internal fields (created_by, provisioned_organization_id, _id)
seed_data_creation: Test packets created and cleaned up during testing. One provisioned packet (TEST_Provision_Complete) remains as it cannot be deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Customer Onboarding Packets feature fully implemented and tested. All backend endpoints work correctly with proper RBAC (403 for non-admin). Public form has 7-step wizard with autosave. Admin panel has full CRUD + provision/reject functionality. One minor HTML nesting warning in dev mode (Badge inside p tag) - cosmetic only.

mocked_apis.resend_email: Password reset emails sent via Resend API - may not deliver in test environment but endpoint does not fail
